viewing_check: 1) Confirm where the 55/72 is marked and whether lots 838 and 844 come with matching paperwork. 2) Check fill and capsule for seepage, and whether the magnum is cork or screw cap (the 750 ml was screw cap). 3) Ask about storage. On drinking, the most recent 750 ml note (Feb 2026) puts it near its peak, and a magnum should be a little behind that.
